title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection | Mediterranean Blue | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch | Allied Brass, Mediterranean Blue
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass for reliable everyday use in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Designed as part of the Carolina Collection, this straight bar helps keep towels within reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Mounting plates and installation hardware included
- Coordinates with other versatile bath accessories in the Carolina Collection

Specs:
- Collection: Carolina Collection
- Style: Traditional
- Bar shape: Straight bar
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Bar diameter: 0.75 in
- Overall size: 30 in L x 2 in W x 3.5 in H
- Projection: 2 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
Multiple designer finishes available
